component.name: Zen Launcher
component.summary: Game library manager and mod loader helper for Linux

description.p: Zen Launcher is a local-first game library manager for Linux. It scans the folders of games you already own — DRM-free purchases, freeware, mods, total conversions, retro titles and plain game directories — and keeps them in one library with artwork, play time and recent games. No store clients, no accounts, no telemetry.

Games launch straight from the library, including Windows titles through a per-game Wine prefix that is set up automatically. A Big Picture mode offers a console-style, gamepad-driven interface for the couch.

A built-in mod loader catalog helps with common modding setups such as Ultimate ASI Loader, CLEO, BepInEx, MelonLoader or tModLoader. Loaders and archives can be installed per game, manual loader links are supported, and an update checker keeps installed loaders current. Client adapters for SA-MP, FiveM and MTA launch multiplayer clients for supported games.
